review.gallery: Five original Neila renders, including two JRE interiors matched to the visible developer factsheet. Unrelated lifestyle and streetscape imagery excluded.
review.location: Al Furjan location and eight estimates from the project factsheet verified visually. JRE and Madena publish the same rounded project coordinates, in the broader Jebel Ali Village area. The site pin is identified as broker-published.
review.floorPlans: Seven AFRA-036 floor plates cover floors 1–9, with 3, 6 and 7 grouped. Two full labelled unit drawings from Property Finder have exact floor, type, apartment area and balcony area, visually verified and reconciled.

unavailable: A complete publicly accessible unit-specific schedule and exact entrance and measured route distances were not established. Detailed Bayut index pages did not allow reliable access.
